title: „Ремонт и рехабилитация на съществуващи метални конструкции на обекти: Калиакра 1, Балчик 1, Траката, Пост 2, Фичоза, РПЦ Китка, Емине, Поморие и връх Китка, част от системата VTMIS“
description: Обществената поръчка цели възстановяване и увеличаване на функционалността, безопасността и експлоатационната годност на обекти, експлоатирани от СПД „Ръководство на корабния трафик – Черно море“, като се предвижда извършване на ремонт и рехабилитация на 8 броя ЖРК, 1 брой метална конструкция за монтаж на радар и 2 броя метални мачти, разположени в области Добрич, Варна и Бургас. title: SECOND STANDARD CALL FOR PROPOSALS FOR LUXIMPULSE PROGRAMME ACTIVITIES
description: The Luxembourg's National Programme - LuxIMPULSE Programme, aims to strengthen worldwide competitiveness of Luxembourg industry in the near term in existing markets and to establish strategic capabilities which will result in stronger competitiveness in the medium term on existing or new markets, and to support the implementation of Luxembourg national priorities.The Call for Proposals is addressed only to economic operators - be it as Prime or Subcontractor level - registered in Luxembourg, unless otherwise instructed and approved by the Luxembourg Space Agency. The proposed work shall not overlap with any currently running ESA Contract awarded to any entity in the proposal consortium.Activities submitted in the frame of LuxIMPULSE Programme may be related to the study, improvement or development of space systems, subsystems, technology, ground systems for space applications, or downstream service products based on space data.It must be noted that according to the Procurement Regulations ESA/REG/001 rev. 5, Art. 18, Tenderers areeligible to participate in a tendering procedure of the Agency provided they possess the necessary professional and technical qualifications, professional and technical competences, financial resources, equipment and other physical facilities, managerial capability, reliability, experience and the personnel, to perform a Contract.The support to the activity by the Luxembourg Space Agency is mandatory. The activities selected will be funded by the Agency at a level depending on the nature of the economic operator and the maturity and proximity to market of the activity. The remainder will be funded by the economic operator's internal own resources and shall not include any additional source of public funding. The economic operator's contribution can be either monetary or in-kind.

title: Cont SyscadRTK- 1 an/doua conexiuni simultan
description:
SysCAD Solutions SRL, companie aflata din 2002 pe piata de distributie de echipamente topografice, a lansat in luna Octombrie 2019 reteaua privata de statii GPS permanente pentru corectii GNSS in timp real. Reteaua are in componenta sa un numar de 50 de statii de referinta ce receptioneaza si utilizeaza semnalul satelitar de la principalele constelatii satelitare (GPS + GLONASS + BEIDOU + GALILEO) si se adreseaza atat utilizatorilor de echipamente GNSS destinate masuratorilor topografice cat si agricultorilor si producatorilor de masini si utilaje agricole ce necesita corectii GPS pentru o pozitionare precisa. Corectiile sunt disponibile in format standard RTCM si ofera precizie centimetrica cu acoperire nationala. Suplimentar SysCAD Solutions ofera si fisiere pentru masuratori GNSS statice in format RINEX 2.1 la interval de 5 secunde. Reteaua poate fi testata gratuit timp de doua zile, atat prin generarea automata pe siteul syscadrtk.ro a unui cont DEMO, precum si prin contactarea inginerilor de retea prin email la adresa office@cadsolutions.ro
Awardee: Syscad Solutions

title: Tartu valla lumetõrjetööd 2020/2021
description: Tartu Valla Kommunaal OÜ hangib Tartu valla kõrvalteede lumetõrjetööd. Kõrvalteede all mõistetakse Tartu valla territooriumil olevaid teid, mis kuuluvad Tartu vallale ehk avalikud teed või erateed, millede osas on seatud maa kasutamise õigus Tartu valla kasuks või erateed, mis viivad Tartu valla elanike elukohtadesse. Hankes on Tartu valla territoorium jaotatud 16-ks lumetõrje piirkonnaks. Hanke osad ei ole piirkonnad 1, 2, 12 ja 16, sest nendes piirkondades teostab lumetõrjet Tellija ise. Samuti ei hõlma hange kergliiklusteede libeduse- ja lumetõrjet ning kõrvalteede libedusetõrjet. Need tööd teostab Tellija ise. Lumetõrje piirkonnas tuleb teostada vastavalt tehnilisel kirjeldusele. Pakkuja on kohustatud esitama kinnituse kasutatava tehnika kohta. Lumetõrjepiirkonnaga saab tutvuda GIS-kaardil, millele viitav link on põhilise asukoha all. description: Gegenstand des Loses ist die regelmäßige Reinigung sämtlicher Glas- und Rahmenflächen an den Standorten Große Präsidentenstraße 9 und Friedrichstraße 153a in Berlin der Auftraggeberin FFA. Die Reinigung umfasst sowohl Innen- als auch Außenflächen der Fenster, einschließlich feststehender Glasteile, Rahmen, Falze und Fensterbänke, sofern diese Teil der Fensterkonstruktion sind. Die Leistung umfasst insbesondere: Reinigung sämtlicher Fenster- und Glasflächen innen und außen einschließlich feststehender Glaselemente, Reinigung der Rahmenflächen innen und außen, Reinigung der Falze und ggf. vorhandener Fensterbänke (sofern nicht Teil der Innenreinigung), Nachreinigung und Nachtrocknen sämtlicher gereinigter Flächen, Einsatz geeigneter, materialschonender Reinigungsmittel und -geräte, Entfernung von Verschmutzungen wie Staub, Fingerabdrücken, Regenrückständen, Insektenresten etc., Abschlusskontrolle der gereinigten Bereiche und Beseitigung von Rückständen. Die Reinigung erfolgt turnusmäßig wie folgt: Außenreinigung der Glas- und Rahmenflächen: 2-mal jährlich (Frühjahr und Herbst), Innenreinigung der Glas- und Rahmenflächen: 1-mal jährlich, Sonderreinigung auf Abruf (z. B. nach Bauarbeiten oder außergewöhnlicher Verschmutzung). Es bestehen keine besonderen Zugangsbeschränkungen. Einzelne Büros (z. B. Vorstandsbereiche) sind nach Absprache zu reinigen. Die Reinigung erfolgt mit Leiter oder Teleskopsystemen, Hubarbeitsbühnen sind nicht erforderlich (max. Arbeitshöhe 4,5 m). Außenjalousien sind nicht Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung. Die Arbeiten dürfen ausschließlich werktags durchgeführt werden. Die Ausführung soll bevorzugt in den frühen Morgenstunden bzw. außerhalb der Hauptnutzungszeiten der Büros erfolgen. Abweichungen sind vorab mit der Auftraggeberin abzustimmen. Es sind klare, streifenfreie Oberflächen ohne Rückstände sicherzustellen. Rahmen und Falze sind vollständig zu reinigen. Nach Fertigstellung erfolgt eine Sicht- und Stichprobenprüfung durch die Auftraggeberin. Bei Beanstandungen sind Nacharbeiten unverzüglich und ohne Mehrkosten durchzuführen. Die Abrechnung erfolgt nach den im Preisblatt anzugebenden Stundenpreisen auf Basis des tatsächlichen Leistungsaufwands. Im Stundenpreis sind sämtliche Nebenleistungen enthalten, insbesondere: An- und Abfahrt, Reinigung, Trocknung und Kontrolle, Bereitstellung der Geräte und Reinigungsmittel, Entsorgung von Reststoffen, Reinigung der Arbeitsgeräte nach Einsatzende. Nach jedem Reinigungsturnus ist ein Leistungsnachweis vorzulegen mit Datum, bearbeitetem Bereich, eingesetztem Personal und Reinigungsumfang. Ziel ist die dauerhafte Gewährleistung eines gepflegten Erscheinungsbilds und der Werterhaltung der Glas- und Rahmenflächen an den Standorten.

title: 5G REGENERATIVE PROCESSOR AND ASSOCIATED SYSTEM TESTBED (ARTES SPL 5G/6G 5A.083) - RE-ISSUE
description: The objective of this activity is to implement and test the signal processing portion of a 5G LEO satellite payload capable of handling several high throughput beams assuming an active antenna configuration. The demonstrator shall be based on a processor capable of controlling a reconfigurable beam-forming network (BFN) and performing signal (re-)generation andchannelisation of 5G waveforms. Targeted Improvements: Enable 5G regenerative payload functionalities currently not available. Description:The number of 5G subscriptions is estimated to reach 3.5 billion by the end of 2026. In this context, providing a truly ubiquitous coverage (even when traveling on cruises, high-speed trains and airplanes) whilst ensuring appropriate quality of service requires a tight integration between satellite and terrestrial networks. While geo-stationary satellites are well suited for covering very large areas with a limited number of satellites, they do not provide an optimal global interactive broadband connectivity due to their large delays and relatively high beam footprint on ground. For this type of service, constellations of hundreds or thousands of satellites in low orbit are preferred thanks to their lower latency and ability to provide higher overall system throughput. In order to achieve the ambitious targets expected by 5G New Radio (e.g., very high data rates, resources flexibility, mesh connectivity and rapid adaptation to traffic variations), these LEO payloads must rely on advanced technologies like phased array antennas, optical inter-satellite links and on-board regeneration. While solutions for on-board regeneration with DVB or CCSDS waveforms already exist, these cannot be exploited for the required integration of the space segment within the 5G ecosystem. This activity shall design and validate the main signal processing components for advanced satellite payloads providing 5G broadband connectivity. Specifically, the focus shall be put on developing the following components:1) High-speed modems capable of (re-)generating 5G waveforms with multiple Gbps of aggregated throughput.2) The on-board processor including switching/routing and control paths to connect the modems to the BFN to send/receive the signals to/from the different beam direction. The testbed shall be composed of the regenerative processor plus the appropriate ground support equipment to perform functional and performance verification of the developed payload components, including functionally representative building blocks of the payload front-end. As a minimum, this shall include a beam-forming network capable of generating multiple beams and capable of controlling hundreds of phased array feeds. It shall also be capable of verifying performance at system level (capacity) and link level (BER, FER, throughput) by simulating the impact of the components not developed within the testbed (e.g. antenna).

title: LEO CONSTELLATIONS REAL-TIME RADIO RESOURCE MANAGEMENT DEMONSTRATOR - EXPRO PLUS RE-ISSUE
description: To develop an active antenna combined software and hardware demonstrator representative of a LEO satellite payload by exploiting advanced strategies for real time dynamically managing radio resources.Description: On-board satellite resource allocationstrategiesare essential for managing the distribution of limited resources from the antennas to multiple user terminals. These strategies involve dynamic allocation techniques that can adjust in real-time based on traffic demand. However, in dense traffic scenarios like onboard LEO satellites, these strategies face significant challenges. The high volume of demand can lead to congestion, resulting in increased latency and reduced QoS. Additionally, the limited on-board processing capability challenges the satellite's ability to efficiently manage traffic which leads to degraded antenna performance. Considering these challenges, the objective of this activity isto develop an active antenna combined software and hardware demonstrator representative of a LEO satellite payload by exploiting advanced strategies for dynamically managing radio resources, i.e. beamforming for real time tracking and coverage change combined with power and bandwidth allocation. Resource allocation should be defined as an optimization problem, considering factors like channelconditions, user demands, interference levels, and power constraints. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Derive real-time complex coefficients, using optimization strategies for the beamforming network. - Emulate users' movement and channel changes for proactive beam steering. - Develop models to detect and classify interference sources and use optimization techniquesfor mitigation. - Manufacture and test a proof-of-concept hardware demonstrator with a limited size active phased array and associated adaptivebeamforming, mounted on a mechanically movable platform with additional antennas located in fixed positions.
